algorithm: One preselected FP32 FEM trajectory in a device-controlled CUDA Graph, followed by conditional-QUBO CPU refinement
timing: Fresh standalone C++/CUDA executable, parent launch through host-available refined partition. Input/model/cached-mode loading, CUDA initialization, graph preparation/search/readout and CPU refinement included. Prior mode construction and policy calibration, audit and archival excluded.
cuda_timing: Wall interval for one CUDA Graph submission through completed host readout; excludes input/model/context/graph preparation and CPU refinement; not a complete solver latency.
statistics: Best cut of three trials; median per-trial full process time and median CUDA interval from those same three runs; not time to best-of-three cut

stopping_protocol.definition: Three consecutive feasible current cuts equal the same feasible best at 64-update checks (window128); unchanged terminal verification.
stopping_protocol.terminal: Unchanged final-temperature/final-penalty zero-catalyst verification, minimum64/max144 updates; minimum two stable terminal checks.

refinement_protocol: Same gain algorithm, eight passes, at most20000 considered moves per pass,512-stall cap; wall-clock guards removed, all actual CPU time charged.
